tools.name: list_zen_knowledge
tools.title: List ZEN Knowledge Base
tools.description: List pages in the ZEN AI Co. Knowledge Base. Optionally filter by a search term matched against page titles and tags. Returns each page's id, title, and tags.

query.description: Optional search term to filter pages by title or tag.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return (default 50).

tools.name: get_zen_knowledge_page
tools.title: Get ZEN Knowledge Page
tools.description: Fetch the full content of a single ZEN AI Co. Knowledge Base page as Markdown. Provide the page id returned by list_zen_knowledge.

page_id.description: The Notion page id from list_zen_knowledge (e.g. 33a9c471-...).
